identity.title: Technical Specification Action Not Taken for Unrecognized Inoperable Reactor Protection System (RPS) and Engineered Safety Feature Actuation System (ESFAS) Instrument Channel Functional Units

cause.proximate_text: A technical error in the shutdown calibration procedure caused an incorrect streaming constant to be installed for one RCS hot leg RTD, resulting in an inaccurate Tave input to the Eagle 21 Channel II ESFAS functions. The inaccurate Tave value caused a setpoint calculation error during the subsequent 100% power calibration, causing the Eagle 21 Channel II OTDT and OPDT RPS setpoints to exceed the allowable values described in Tech Specs.

nodes.description: Inaccurate streaming constant installed for RCS hot leg RTD, affecting Tave/RCS temperature calculations for Eagle 21 Channel II.
Three ESFAS Functional Units (1f, 4d, 8b) rendered inoperable from Mode 3 entry until first 100% power calibration on 5/6/2020, without TS actions taken.

nodes.display_name: Erroneous OTDT/OPDT setpoint constants installed at 100% power calibration
nodes.description: Because of the inaccurate Tave input, inaccurate OTDT and OPDT setpoint constants were installed during the 100% power calibration.
OTDT and OPDT RPS allowable setpoints in TS Table 2.2-1 were exceeded, rendering the OTDT and OPDT RPS functions inoperable from 5/6 15:00 until discovery on 5/7 11:25.
